title: Dashboard
description: Welcome back! Here's an overview of your security posture.
noActiveFrameworksDesc: Activate a compliance framework to start tracking your readiness and coverage

launchpad.title: Prepare for compliance
launchpad.subtitle: You have not activated a framework yet. Start with a framework, then complete the setup steps below to build your compliance foundation.

activateFramework.title: Activate a framework
activateFramework.description: Choose the compliance standard you want to prepare for, such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

connectSystems.title: Connect systems and sync users
connectSystems.description: Bring in identity, cloud, HR, and device data so Cloudanzen can track your posture accurately.

reviewAccess.title: Review access and assign owners
reviewAccess.description: Confirm who owns systems, who has access, and where reviews are needed.

createPolicies.title: Create or generate policies
createPolicies.description: Set up the core policies your framework will expect, then review and publish them.

reviewRisks.title: Review risks and gaps
reviewRisks.description: Capture the major risks and understand what needs treatment before audit preparation.

startTests.title: Start tests and collect evidence
startTests.description: Begin recurring checks and evidence collection so your program becomes measurable.

soc-2.bestFor: Teams selling into US B2B customers and building a practical trust program.

iso-27001.bestFor: Teams building a formal ISMS and preparing for globally recognized certification.

hipaa.bestFor: Healthcare and regulated teams focused on safeguarding sensitive data and operational controls.

myTasks.title: My Tasks
myTasks.description: Your assigned tests and pending security tasks.
myTasks.noPendingTests: No pending tests assigned to you.
myTasks.acceptPoliciesDesc: Read and accept all published org policies
myTasks.enrollMdmDesc: Install the Manzen MDM agent on your Mac
myTasks.securityTrainingDesc: Complete the interactive security awareness training
